name: When does the warranty period for construction work begin after project closeout?

mainEntity.name: When does the warranty period for construction work begin after project closeout?

acceptedAnswer.text: The warranty period for construction work typically begins upon substantial completion of the project, which usually aligns with the project closeout and final sign-off. This is when the property is essentially ready for occupancy or use, even if minor punch list items remain. Frasheski Construction provides clear documentation outlining the start date and duration of all applicable warranties for your project, ensuring transparency regarding your investment in areas like South San Francisco or East San Francisco.
acceptedAnswer.description: The warranty period usually starts at project closeout, upon substantial completion and final sign-off of the construction.
